User: I have been traveling, so I actually have not had fast food in the last two weeks. Yeah.
Agent: Thanks for letting me know, Sean. Traveling can definitely change eating habits.

Since you haven't had fast food recently, let's talk about what "good value" means to you in fast food. Could you pick your top two or three factors from taste, portion size, speed, nutrition, consistency, and price, and explain how you judge if something is "worth it"?
